$comment: QC-5801 ship-to-shore container crane twin. Expected values and design-working-period clocks in Maximo Monitor from the maker's data sheet and the crane standards; the crane sends only what its crane management system measures and counts.

identification.model: Ship-to-shore gantry crane, Super Post Panamax size
identification.description: Quay crane on berth 58 of a container terminal: discharges and loads container ships
identification.structure: Single lattice main beam and boom (hinged), A-frame, portal on four corners with rail wheels
identification.hoist: Main hoist: two winch drums driven by electric motors through a gearbox, rope reeving to the trolley and the headblock
identification.trolley: Self-powered trolley on the main beam and boom rails, every wheel driven and braked
identification.spreader: Telescopic twin-lift spreader under a headblock: one 20 ft, 40 ft or 45 ft box, or two 20 ft boxes
identification.boom: Boom hoist: raises the boom to 80 degrees out of operation and when a ship berths or leaves
identification.gantry: Gantry travel drives on the quay rails, rail clamps and storm pins
identification.cms: Crane management system (CMS): load cells, drive data, counters, fault log

geometry.source: Liebherr STS technical data sheet 2026 (v2), Super Post Panamax column: outreach up to 55 m, lift height 40 m, backreach 0-25 m, span 15-35 m. The backreach (20 m) and the span (30.5 m, 100 ft) of QC-5801 are an assumption: typical value, replace with your crane's general arrangement drawing

rated.source: Liebherr STS technical data sheet 2026 (v2), Super Post Panamax column: safe working load 40-50 t single, 65 t twin, under the spreader (the upper end of the single range is used). Mass of the spreader and headblock carried by the ropes (15 t): assumption: typical value, replace with the weights on your spreader and headblock name plates

hoist.source: Liebherr STS technical data sheet 2026 (v2), Super Post Panamax column: hoisting speed 70-175 m/min, read as 70 m/min with the rated load and 175 m/min with the empty spreader (the 2020 description writes the same pair as 'rated / empty', e.g. 90/180). The drive holds constant power between the two (field weakening). Efficiency from the electrical input to the load (motor, gearbox, drums, reeving): assumption: typical value, replace with the drive's commissioning data

trolley.source: Liebherr STS technical data sheet 2026 (v2), Super Post Panamax column: trolley speed 210-240 m/min (upper end used). Trolley wheel diameter new (630 mm), discard diameter (620 mm) and expected wear (0.5 mm per 1000 km of travel): assumption: typical value, replace with the maker's maintenance manual and your own wheel history

gantry.source: Liebherr STS technical data sheet 2026 (v2), Super Post Panamax column: travel speed 45 m/min. Liebherr STS technical description 02/2020, typical design parameters: in-service wind speed 72 km/h (20 m/s), out-of-service 151.2 km/h (42 m/s). Your crane's own wind limits are on its design calculation and operating manual.

classification.source: Liebherr STS technical description 02/2020, typical design parameters: classification according to F.E.M. U7-Q2-A7. ISO 12482:2014 Tables A.1, A.2, A.3 and B.3: DN for U7 = 2 000 000 work cycles, Kp for Q2 = 0.25, DC for A7 = 500 000, DM for M8 = 12 500 h; Table 1: f1 = 1.0 for an automatic recording system. Hoist mechanism group M8: assumption: typical value, replace with the mechanism classification on your crane's design documents (not on the data sheet)

rope.source: ISO 16625:2013 Table 1 (Zp = 9.0 for M8, single-layer spooling) and Table 4 (sheave factor h2 = 28.0 for M8). ISO 4309:2017 Table 5, single-layer rope with steel core: decrease in diameter slight from 3.5 %, discard at 7.5 % of nominal, measured from the reference diameter after installation. Number of falls, reeving efficiency, rope size and minimum breaking force, reference diameter, rope type factor t, bends per move and the rope life of 120 000 moves: assumption: typical value, replace with the rope certificate, the reeving drawing and your own rope history

brake.source: Hoist service brake (disc brake with thrusters) release time and pad thickness, new and minimum: assumption: typical value, replace with the brake maker's manual

spreader.source: Twistlock faults (lock or unlock not confirmed, retries) per 1000 twistlock cycles: assumption: typical value, replace with your spreader fault history

operation.source: Gross crane rate (moves per hour), hoist running hours and moves per year, and the container mix (share of moves, payload under the spreader in t): assumption: typical value, replace with your terminal operating system (TOS) move history

demo.note: Demo only: one container move takes 120 s of real time (30 moves per hour). The lifetime counters, the rope and wheel measurements and the 24-hour and 30-day statistics come from the failure modes, not from the demo clock.

groups.Duty: Duty counters for the design working period

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it (full severity first, then any that show on the way).

brake_drag.name: Hoist brake dragging (thruster or air gap)
brake_drag.symptoms: hoist power above what the load and speed need, slow brake release

brake_pad_wear.name: Hoist brake pads worn
brake_pad_wear.symptoms: pad wear sensor near the minimum thickness

rope_wear.name: Hoist rope worn past its life
rope_wear.symptoms: diameter shrinks against the reference, moves since change beyond the rope life

twistlock_faults.name: Spreader twistlock faults
twistlock_faults.symptoms: lock / unlock not confirmed, retries, the crane rate drops

trolley_wheel_wear.name: Trolley wheel wear (misalignment, skew)
trolley_wheel_wear.symptoms: wheel diameter falls faster than the travel explains

snag_overload.name: Snag loads (spreader caught in a cell guide)
snag_overload.symptoms: load-cell peaks above the safe working load, snag events logged

wind_operation.name: Working on in rising wind
wind_operation.symptoms: wind at the top of the crane near or above the in-service limit while the crane works
